description: Residential electric vehicle charging datasets from apartment buildings is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Åse Lekang Sørensen (SINTEF, NTNU). The reported datasets deal with residential electric vehicle (EV) charging in apartment buildings. The datasets are described in the Data In Brief article "Residential electric vehicle charging datasets from apartment buildings" (2021, https://doi.org/10.1016/j.dib.2021.107105), and refers to the paper "Analysis of residential EV energy flexibility potential based on real-world charging reports and smart meter data" (https://doi.org/10.1016/j.enbuild.2021.110923). Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
